title: Employee Secretly Films Her Boss — The Internet Is Losing It
description:
Employee Records A (now viral) Video Of Her Toxic Boss And It's Wild!   TikTok culture has bred a new form of employment trend - recording every interaction with the "toxic" boss and sharing it across the internet.  My advice is to STOP recording your boss and posting it online, because in the end, it only hurts your career.  Getting that out of the way, who's at fault here?  This one is for you to decide.  

00:00 - Start
00:43 - The employee's backstory
02:52 - The background story in her words
03:57 - When you get a new boss, beware.
05:35 - "The boss doesn't do anything."
09:10 - HR isn't your friend
12:36 - The EEOC Declines to investigate (RED FLAG)
13:28 - How complaints are handled at the EEOC
15:32 - Two-party consent for recordings
17:04 - The actual conversation with the "toxic boss"
22:04 - Argumentative employee, angry boss
27:02 - "I think your reaction is inappropriate."
31:52 - How she should have handled it
34:06 - The Cease And Desist Letter (and response)
38:42 - The aftermath
